connector.name: FiatDock
connector.registryDescription: Non-custodial USDC <-> bank for AI agents via x402 + Transak. Own funds only; PT + EU/EEA; 18+.
connector.summary: Hosted at fiatdock.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package fiatdock-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.fiatdock, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Agent wallet key that auto-pays the $0.05 USDC x402 fee for paid tools. Optional: free tools (get_quote, get_order_status) work without it. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

env.name: FIATDOCK_MAX_PRICE_USD
env.description: Price-bait guard for call_service: refuse to pay if a paid gateway call's total x402 charge exceeds this many USD. Optional (default: no ceiling); overridable per call via the maxPriceUsd argument.
